content: {"like":["Prefers gripping, tense dramas with strong pacing and clear central mystery.","Values authentic, true stories with compelling, well‑acted performances.","Enjoys dark, moody atmospherics and chilling, intense themes.","Appreciates technical excellence and engaging, evolving plotlines.","Likes focused storytelling with minimal distracting subplots or banter."],"dislike":["Dislikes slow, drawn‑out pacing and continuity glitches.","Avoids films with too many characters or convoluted plots.","Prefers subtitles for accented dialogue; dislikes lack thereof.","Rejects bleak, gothic portrayals that lack humor or lightness.","Dislikes films that include silly banter or child‑centric distractions."]}
